Welcome to the Unwind Cabin, a charming retreat perfectly tailored for couples, honeymooners, and even small families seeking an unforgettable getaway. The cabin is located in Hochatown, OK,  and minutes from the beautiful Broken Bow Lake and Beavers Bend State Park off of Camp Ranch Road.

In town, you'll discover a wide array of fun tourist attractions, ranging from outdoor adventures like hiking and fishing to relaxing boat rentals on the lake. Additionally, the area is home to a variety of tasty dining destinations, offering everything from local cuisine to delightful eateries that cater to every palate. As well as, breweries, distilleries, and wineries to test out. Whether you're seeking thrilling activities or a leisurely day of dining and exploration, Hochatown and Broken Bow have something for everyone to enjoy!

This exquisite one-bedroom cabin boasts multiple amenities that will make your stay truly special. The open-concept living room and kitchen create a warm and inviting atmosphere, highlighted by cathedral ceilings. The centerpiece of the area is the mountain rock double-sided fireplace, providing both warmth and character to the space. The living area features a plush leather couch and chairs, perfect for relaxing with your significant other after a day of adventure. You will also find a convenient wine fridge to store your favorite bottles during your stay. The kitchen boasts granite countertops and comes fully equipped with all the essentials needed to prepare a meal. This seamless blend of comfort and functionality makes it the perfect setting for romantic evenings.

When stepping into the luxurious master bedroom, a haven of comfort and style featuring a stunning cathedral ceiling that adds an airy elegance to the space awaits you. Enjoy the warmth of the double-sided gas fireplace, which creates a cozy ambiance perfect for intimate moments. The ensuite bathroom boasts a soaker tub, inviting you to indulge in long, relaxing baths after a day of exploration. As well as a walk-in tile shower, providing both functionality and sophistication.

Step outside onto the deck and “unwind” in the hot tub, surrounded on two sides by a secluded privacy fence, providing the perfect space for relaxation. Enjoy the warmth of the wood-burning fireplace as you sit back on the comfortable L-shaped couch while watching your favorite shows on the TV. For alfresco dining, there's a bar top table with two chairs for a cozy meal or drinks under the stars. Additionally, an attached gazebo features outdoor dining for four, making it an ideal spot for enjoying meals in the fresh air. This inviting outdoor space is designed to enhance your experience, allowing you to soak in the serene surroundings while enjoying all the comforts of home.

This serene retreat is designed to make your stay truly memorable, ensuring you feel pampered throughout your getaway. Experience the perfect blend of comfort and adventure at the Unwind Cabin—your ideal escape into nature!

This cabin is managed by Bear Mountain Management.

Master King Suite:

*King Bed  *Soaking Tub *Tile Shower *Smart TV-Flat Screen with Roku Streaming 
*Linens & Towels (including hot tub towels) *Blow Dryer *Cathedral ceiling *Ceiling Fan
*Shampoo, Conditioner, Shower Gel, and Lotion  

Fully Equipped Kitchen:

*Electric Stove *Refrigerator *Oven *Dishwasher *Microwave *Toaster *Blender *Keurig Coffee Maker and a Mr. Coffee *Mixer *Cookware *Cookie sheets  *Cake Pans *Flatware *Dishes *Wine Opener *Wine Glasses  *Granite Countertops *Dining Table w/2 Chairs *Kitchen Bar w/ 2 Chairs 

Living Room:

*Couch *Chair *Double sided Gas Fireplace *Roku TV  Wine Rack *Wine Fridge *Cathedral Ceiling *Ceiling Fan

Outdoors:

Back Deck:
*Hot Tub (Drained & sanitized after each stay) *Privacy fence by the Hot Tub  
*Gas Grill (Propane is provided for grill) *L-Shaped Couch * Wood burning Fireplace *Outdoor Bar Table and 2 Chairs * Roku TV

Attached Gazebo: *Outdoor Dining Table w/ 4 Chairs *Ceiling fan

Front Porch: *2 chairs *Bench

 *HorseShoe Pit *Fire Pit *Hammock *Cornhole *Ladder Toss/Golf Ball Toss *Pipe Ball 

Miscellaneous:

*Central Heat/Air *Washer/Dryer *Free Wifi *Additional blankets *Poker cards *Jenga *Uno, Dominos *Skip-bo * First Aid Kit *Fire Extinguisher * Self Check-in/Out 

*All TVs are equipped with smart technology, allowing guests to log in to their personal streaming accounts for a seamless entertainment experience.

*Starter supply of coffee, sugar, salt, pepper, paper towels, toilet paper, hand soap, dishwashing tabs, trash bags, and laundry soap will be provided.

*NO SMOKING*
*PET FRIENDLY*

07/2025 

My partner and I absolutely loved our stay at this luxury home/cabin. Everything was exactly as described and pictured. Unwind was overly squeaky clean as well!! The neighborhood is very quiet and the surroundings are extremely beautiful. The host was very helpful and responsive. I would definitely book this cabin again and would recommend everyone else to do so!
~ DeAndrea

 03/2025 

Great communication with Toni from start to finish. She sent directions to the cabin,as the street didn’t pull up on the map. There were cabins close by but very private at the same time. The place was so comfortable & decorated so cute. The bed was like heaven! We had the best sleep… such a quiet area. The cabin is stocked with everything you could need. We felt truly at home & the dual fireplace inside is everything! We also used the hot tub nightly. I’d highly recommend this place!!!
~ Corrie

12/2024 

We had a wonderful time at the Unwind cabin. It really is a place to "unwind"!  The cabin was so beautiful, cozy, but spacious and super comfortable. High quality furniture, linens and the bed was really comfortable. I didn’t want to get up! Kitchen is very well equipped and very clean. The hot tub was such a lovely touch ,and it was clean and well maintained, a great place to relax after exploring for the day. The added Christmas tree made it really festive. We were sad to leave, but we would definitely book again! Also Toni, the host, was lovely and sent us easy instructions and helpful information about the area and made sure we were happy with everything. Honestly one of my favourite stays, and I would highly recommend it.
~ Kelly

08/2024

It was an absolutely perfect stay. The design and layout of the cabin is wonderful. So much outdoor square footage, including outdoor television, fireplace,  gazebo and fire pit. To go along with a beautifully designed interior with a see-through, gas fireplace, large bedroom, comfortable bed and beautiful master bath. All that it says it is and more.
~Mike & Jan

01/2024

We stayed at the Unwind cabin to celebrate our wedding anniversary. It was the perfect spot for us to just hang out and relax! The double sided fireplace was great to be able to enjoy either in the living room or the bedroom. Outdoor space was cozy as well with an outdoor fireplace, hot tub and two sitting areas. Will definitely be back!!
~Dorie

CHECK-IN:  Check-in begins at 4:00 PM. If you plan to arrive after 4:00 PM, please email us at bearmountainlodging@gmail.com. This will help us better prioritize our cleaning schedule during the busy times of year. {{roomname}}  is a self check-in cabin, and you will receive your directions via email 7 days before your arrival.

 

CHECK-OUT:  Check-out is at 11:00 AM.  To make departure day more efficient for everyone, please text  580-212-4746 if you decide to depart early.  This will help us with getting the next guest in on time. Owner is not responsible for items left in the cabin.  If requested, items will be shipped for a $25.00 handling fee plus actual shipping costs.

 

Renter agrees to maintain cleanliness of the cabin during their stay and leave the cabin in a reasonably clean condition when they depart.  All dirty dishes should be placed in the dishwasher and turned on before leaving the cabin.  Refrigerator needs to be emptied of all food.  Tie up trash bags and place them in outside containers.  Please start a load of towels before your departure.  Please do not strip the beds. (The cleaning staff will take care of that and all of the rest!) Excessive cleaning fees could apply if policy is not followed. 

 

DOWN PAYMENT:  We accept Visa, Mastercard, or Discover.  You will need to use one of the major credit cards to make a reservation.  The down payment (Reservation Fee) is 20% of the cost of the total reservation.  Down payments are applied toward the balance.  The down payment (Reservation Fee) is nonrefundable.

 

FINAL PAYMENT:  The balance is due 30 days prior to your arrival.

 

AGE REQUIREMENT:  You must be 21 years of age to reserve this vacation rental.   We reserve the right to refuse service with monies forfeited if any discrepancies in our policies are suspected.

MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY- 4 people:  Do not exceed the maximum occupancy allowed for the cabin.  Guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees.  We do require a list of names and ages of guests before your arrival if you did not provide it at the time of your reservation.

 

RESERVATION REQUIREMENT: There is a 2 night minimum required.  There is a 3 or 4 night minimum for holidays and high peak season. 

 

CHANGING CABINS OR DATES:  Date changes or removing nights are subject to a $50 fee.  You cannot make a change if you are within 30 days of your arrival date. Reservations  cannot be moved from one cabin to another. 

 

NO HOUSE PARTIES OR EVENTS:  House parties or events are strictly prohibited.  Rental guests understand that we will accept families, married couples, and responsible adults 21 years of age and older ONLY.  Renters acknowledge that violation of this agreement will lead to your being required to leave with NO refund.  Guests must state, in advance, the number of renters/guests during their stay at {{roomname}} .

 

ATV RIDING IS PROHIBITED ON THE PREMISES:  It is illegal to ride ATVs on the area roads also if you are not properly tagged. 

 

PETS NOT ALLOWED:  We know you love your fur babies, and we do too. However, we do not allow pets at our cabins.  Non-Compliance of our NO PET policy will result in a $100 per day charge. Again, guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees.

 

NO DAILY HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE IS PROVIDED.

 

NO SMOKING OF ANY KIND IN CABIN:  We ask that you do not smoke inside the cabin.  Ashtrays will be provided outside.  Please put your cigarette butts in the ashtrays.  Non-compliance will result in a $100 per day charge. 

 

SHOOTING GUNS OR FIREWORKS is prohibited on cabin property. 

 

HOT TUBS & COVERS:  Our hot tubs are cleaned and chemically treated after every rental.  Hot tub use is strictly at your own risk.  Persons with high blood pressure, skin sensitivities, or who might be pregnant are strongly urged not to use a hot tub. 

PLEASE do not allow anyone in your group to walk-on, jump-on or play-on the hot tub covers, they will break.  The condition of the hot tub is checked after every checkout and before your arrival.

 

WE LOVE OUR TREES!  Please do not cut on or cut down trees on the property.  Fines will be charged to your account for damaging trees. 

 

PROPERTY ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT: Please do not tamper with the electronics, television, receivers, etc. equipment in the cabin.  Also please do not unhook or disconnect any cords or wires from any of the equipment.  We do check the TV’s, DirecTv receivers, and surround sound to ensure they are in working order. Please make sure everything is in working order before you leave.   A $100 fee will be charged for unhooking or tampering with any electronic device.

MAINTENANCE PROBLEMS will be addressed in as timely a manner as possible. However the rental rate cannot be adjusted due to any malfunction of equipment (which includes  T.V., VCR, DVD, heating units, hot water heaters, stoves, refrigerators, hot tubs, locks etc). In the extremely rare case where there is a major problem with heat, hot water, etc that makes the home uninhabitable we will try to arrange a different accommodation.  If that is not possible, a prorated amount will be refunded.

 

COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide.  All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS. 

 

LIABILITY NOTICE: Acknowledging this contract signifies you, as the guests, agree to all above policies and certifies you as the guest are 21 years of age or older.  This cabin is privately owned, the homeowners or property management are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities.  The Homeowner or property management are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest.  By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises or others whom they invite to use the premises. 

If anyone neglect to follow the rules, policies, and suggestions of Bear Mountain Management, LLC the guests cannot hold us responsible for their actions, accidents, or neglect.  Once your first payment is received, it is considered a rental agreement and is considered a legal and binding contract.

*Regardless of notice, a cancellation will result in the loss of your Reservation Fee.

*We require a 30-day notice of cancellation. You will forfeit your full amount if the cancellation is made 30 days or less prior to your arrival date.

*We request all cancellations be in writing, via email. We will accept cancellations via phone, but will again request a follow-up email. Only the guest who booked the reservation may cancel a reservation.

*Inclement weather does not make a valid cancellation.

*If the cabin can be rebooked, we will refund you less the Reservation Fee.

*Trip Insurance can be purchased at www.insuremytrip.com. 

COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide.  All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation. Therefore, NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS.

CHECK-IN:  Check-in begins at 4:00 PM. If you plan to arrive after 4:00 PM, please email us at bearmountainlodging@gmail.com. This will help us better prioritize our cleaning schedule during the busy times of year. {{roomname}}  is a self check-in cabin, and you will receive your directions via email 7 days before your arrival.

 

CHECK-OUT:  Check-out is at 11:00 AM.  To make departure day more efficient for everyone, please text  580-212-4746 if you decide to depart early.  This will help us with getting the next guest in on time. Owner is not responsible for items left in the cabin.  If requested, items will be shipped for a $25.00 handling fee plus actual shipping costs.

 

Renter agrees to maintain cleanliness of the cabin during their stay and leave the cabin in a reasonably clean condition when they depart.  All dirty dishes should be placed in the dishwasher and turned on before leaving the cabin.  Refrigerator needs to be emptied of all food.  Tie up trash bags and place them in outside containers.  Please start a load of towels before your departure.  Please do not strip the beds. (The cleaning staff will take care of that and all of the rest!) Excessive cleaning fees could apply if policy is not followed. 

 

DOWN PAYMENT:  We accept Visa, Mastercard, or Discover.  You will need to use one of the major credit cards to make a reservation.  The down payment (Reservation Fee) is 20% of the cost of the total reservation.  Down payments are applied toward the balance.  The down payment (Reservation Fee) is nonrefundable.

 

FINAL PAYMENT:  The balance is due 30 days prior to your arrival.

 

AGE REQUIREMENT:  You must be 21 years of age to reserve this vacation rental.   We reserve the right to refuse service with monies forfeited if any discrepancies in our policies are suspected.

MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY- 4 people:  Do not exceed the maximum occupancy allowed for the cabin.  Guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees.  We do require a list of names and ages of guests before your arrival if you did not provide it at the time of your reservation.

 

RESERVATION REQUIREMENT: There is a 2 night minimum required.  There is a 3 or 4 night minimum for holidays and high peak season. 

 

CHANGING CABINS OR DATES:  Date changes or removing nights are subject to a $50 fee.  You cannot make a change if you are within 30 days of your arrival date. Reservations  cannot be moved from one cabin to another. 

 

NO HOUSE PARTIES OR EVENTS:  House parties or events are strictly prohibited.  Rental guests understand that we will accept families, married couples, and responsible adults 21 years of age and older ONLY.  Renters acknowledge that violation of this agreement will lead to your being required to leave with NO refund.  Guests must state, in advance, the number of renters/guests during their stay at {{roomname}} .

 

ATV RIDING IS PROHIBITED ON THE PREMISES:  It is illegal to ride ATVs on the area roads also if you are not properly tagged. 

 

PETS NOT ALLOWED:  We know you love your fur babies, and we do too. However, we do not allow pets at our cabins.  Non-Compliance of our NO PET policy will result in a $100 per day charge. Again, guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees.

 

NO DAILY HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE IS PROVIDED.

 

NO SMOKING OF ANY KIND IN CABIN:  We ask that you do not smoke inside the cabin.  Ashtrays will be provided outside.  Please put your cigarette butts in the ashtrays.  Non-compliance will result in a $100 per day charge. 

 

SHOOTING GUNS OR FIREWORKS is prohibited on cabin property. 

 

HOT TUBS & COVERS:  Our hot tubs are cleaned and chemically treated after every rental.  Hot tub use is strictly at your own risk.  Persons with high blood pressure, skin sensitivities, or who might be pregnant are strongly urged not to use a hot tub. 

PLEASE do not allow anyone in your group to walk-on, jump-on or play-on the hot tub covers, they will break.  The condition of the hot tub is checked after every checkout and before your arrival.

 

WE LOVE OUR TREES!  Please do not cut on or cut down trees on the property.  Fines will be charged to your account for damaging trees. 

 

PROPERTY ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT: Please do not tamper with the electronics, television, receivers, etc. equipment in the cabin.  Also please do not unhook or disconnect any cords or wires from any of the equipment.  We do check the TV’s, DirecTv receivers, and surround sound to ensure they are in working order. Please make sure everything is in working order before you leave.   A $100 fee will be charged for unhooking or tampering with any electronic device.

MAINTENANCE PROBLEMS will be addressed in as timely a manner as possible. However the rental rate cannot be adjusted due to any malfunction of equipment (which includes  T.V., VCR, DVD, heating units, hot water heaters, stoves, refrigerators, hot tubs, locks etc). In the extremely rare case where there is a major problem with heat, hot water, etc that makes the home uninhabitable we will try to arrange a different accommodation.  If that is not possible, a prorated amount will be refunded.

 

COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide.  All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS. 

 

LIABILITY NOTICE: Acknowledging this contract signifies you, as the guests, agree to all above policies and certifies you as the guest are 21 years of age or older.  This cabin is privately owned, the homeowners or property management are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities.  The Homeowner or property management are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest.  By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises or others whom they invite to use the premises. 

If anyone neglect to follow the rules, policies, and suggestions of Bear Mountain Management, LLC the guests cannot hold us responsible for their actions, accidents, or neglect.  Once your first payment is received, it is considered a rental agreement and is considered a legal and binding contract.

*Regardless of notice, a cancellation will result in the loss of your Reservation Fee.

*We require a 30-day notice of cancellation. You will forfeit your full amount if the cancellation is made 30 days or less prior to your arrival date.

*We request all cancellations be in writing, via email. We will accept cancellations via phone, but will again request a follow-up email. Only the guest who booked the reservation may cancel a reservation.

*Inclement weather does not make a valid cancellation.

*If the cabin can be rebooked, we will refund you less the Reservation Fee.

*Trip Insurance can be purchased at www.insuremytrip.com.
